lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: Grrrr! Woof, woof!

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Bah! Rex, stop barking! What's the matter?

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Hu-How…! IMPOSSIBLE! How did you get through my security system!?

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Security system? I just climbed the side of the cliff… bah! anyways old man. Does Helenna live around here? Need to talk to that inventor.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: I don't know what business a scoundrel like you has with my wife, I don't like visits. Get back to where you came from.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Look old man, it took me while to get to your “home”. If she's here, and she's SLIGHTLY more charming than you, call her, I'll deal with my stuff and leave. My dad needs—

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: She's… not here. Hasn't come back from work yet. It's strange…. She should've been back by now. She's never late…

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: She goes to work from here? How does she get through the maze you've got there?

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: She doesn't have to get through it fool, we have a passage, it just takes longer. But still I should go look for her… maybe there was an issue at the terminal. It's worrying…

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: So, what are we waiting for? Let's go!

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Guessing you'll follow me no matter what I say… At least be useful brat.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: I know it's the house of a genius inventor and all that, but why just have machinery all over the place?

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: They have a use. We'll need to activate the three mechanisms locking the main gate. It'll be quicker than taking the passage.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Help me with these levers first.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Hmph, right, the ladder went missing. How can I reach the switch now?

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Don't worry old man. I got all the way here climbing, remember?

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Oh, sure thing brat, let's see then.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Nina.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: My name.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Okay, boy. Your turn.

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: WOOF!

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: His turn? For what?

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Helping. You have no clue what he's capable of. He's got even more brains and agility than me.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Who doesn't...

lines.speaker: Rex
lines.text: WOOF!

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Huh, I can't remember how to solve this. It was all 3 together somehow.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Why did you guys make your life so complicated again?

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Helenna. She finds this as a “creative” way to train her brain, spend time with me and train Rex.

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: I'll have to use her arm for this one….

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: She designed that? Nice, my dad --

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Move.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Can't you listen a second?

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Hmph. This pad is rusted, we'll need something heavy

lines.speaker: Harold
lines.text: Need to turn all 3 machines on to unlock the gate.
